'''Lucky's Tavern''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] built on [[Floating Home]] before it eventually transitioned into [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]]. Built by [[Lucky Malnock]], it was well situated and originally catered to [[Miner/Legends|miners]] and construction workers. As the colony expanded, the location of the bar meant that its clientele became more suited to administrative workers. Malnock ended up selling the place to a group of investors. After passing through a series of owners, Lucky's Tavern was bought by [[Jacc Mandelbrot]]. Mandelbrot bought neighboring properties and knocked them through into one location, creating the [[Royal Casino/Legends|Royal Casino]].
